goal: Make every table on this site say when it was read, store each filing as a dated event, and give club keys and game ids one canonical form.

path_name: Build the availability and depth signal
goal: Turn 'a starter is out' into a measurable replacement cost, using the club-published depth charts, the official injury report and real playing time.
